title: Reader Workbench gloss selection contract
purpose: Local-only study selections over HUD route cards. These records support under-token gloss display and passage assembly without creating translation-memory rows or publication output.
storage_policy: Browser-local first. Store in IndexedDB where available, localStorage fallback is allowed, and JSON export/import is the only v1 portability path.
publication_policy: Every row must carry publication_status=not_a_translation. Gloss selections are study annotations and must not be interpreted as accepted translations.
selection_rules: Under-token glosses appear only after a user selects a card or imports a local study sheet.
answer_eligible means eligible for the HUD answer slot, not accepted definition authority or publication readiness.
Usage evidence cards remain evidence by default and must not be labeled as selected definitions unless linked to a definition card.
User notes are private study notes and are not evidence rows.
Source/license rows from selected cards must be retained in exports.

source_rows.source_name: Project-authored Reader Workbench gloss selection contract
source_rows.notes: Coordination contract only. It creates no translation output.
